1432-2645-3147-3430.easyPrerequisites: Ioreth of the Healing House doesn't have summoning sickness.
1432-2645-3147-3430.description:
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping Azorius Chancery
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3499-5078-6766-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

826-1636-3899-6243.easyPrerequisites: Amoeboid Changeling does not have summoning sickness.
826-1636-3899-6243.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing another nontoken creature you control to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature targeted in step 1.
When the creature dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield as a white Angel.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1308-4365-4772-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5330-5359-6972.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk.
When Threefold Thunderhulk dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

1003-2626-3967-4986.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4659-5365-5494-7741.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact
4659-5365-5494-7741.description:
Activate Lonis by paying {2} and sacrificing another artifact.
If the artifact was a Clue, Lonis' third ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Lonis ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on it and causing you to draw a card.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis' third ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.
Repeat.

4017-6097-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4017-6097-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The other Hero triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Creature that gains at least 4 life

1703-4050-7439--157.description:
Cast a copy of Channel from exile by paying {G}{G}, unpreparing Yavimaya Bloomsage.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the lifegain creature, adding {U}.
When that creature dies, Fool's Demise's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning that creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When that creature dies or enters (depending on the card), it triggers, gaining at least 4 life.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Use Channel four times by paying 4 life, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Fool's Demise by paying {4}{U}, attaching it to the same creature.
Repeat from step 2.
To achieve the infinite colorless mana and infinite lifegain results, you need to gain at least 5 life per loop.

4271-7439.easyPrerequisites: You control a legendary creature or planeswalker.
4271-7439.description:
Cast a copy of Channel by paying {G}{G}.
Activate the ability granted by Channel by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 as desired.
Cast Jaya's Immolating Inferno by paying {R}{R} and all remaining available mana, dealing a large amount of damage to up to three targets.
4271-7439.notes: The more life you have, the more damage you will deal. You can also add mana as desired from other sources to cast Jaya's Immolating Inferno.

2539-3094-3499-4659-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
2539-3094-3499-4659-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed twice due to Twinning Staff, targeting Lithoform Engine and another artifact card in your graveyard.
Resolve both copies of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine and the other artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the other artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1394-2034-2060-6774-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Loading Zone.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Loading Zone.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

5686-7083-7084.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it and Baloth Prime trigger.
Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Baloth Prime trigger, untapping it and creating a tapped 4/4 Beast creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2060-4518-6930-7056.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

2099-3284-3490-4871.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing another creature you control
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Korvold's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and draw a card.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

443-3705-5231-6896.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Magus of the Bridge triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Repeat.

997-2173-3661-5220.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Shield Sphere
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Cast Shield Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

522-1429-5226.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Melira.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

2267-5058-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

725-767-6702.description:
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Kilo.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a charge counter on Druids' Repository.
Resolve the Aura of Dominion ability, untapping Kilo.
Activate Druids' Repository by removing a charge counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3490-4050-6081.description:
Cast Black Panther either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Black Panther enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a land you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Black Panther triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Black Panther trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a land you control.
Repeat from step 3.
3490-4050-6081.notes: You can have any creature enter the battlefield instead as long as Black Panther is on the battlefield already. You can also start with Black Panther on the battlefield and by placing a +1/+1 counter on a permanent you control, causing the combo to start at step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1115-3259-6664.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control five or more Towns.
1115-3259-6664.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Wandering Minstrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

4364-6426.easyPrerequisites: Sandstorm Crasher does not have summoning sickness.
4364-6426.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
4364-6426.description:
Declare Aurelia and Sandstorm Crasher as attackers, choosing to exert Sandstorm Crasher as it attacks. Aurelia and Sandstorm Crasher each trigger.
Resolve the Sandstorm Crasher trigger, creating a token copy of Aurelia that is tapped and attacking.
Put the oldest Aurelia into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Resolve the Aurelia trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat during each combat phase using the Aurelia token instead.

964-1329-3169-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of artifacts equal to or greater than one plus Emry's commander tax.
964-1329-3169-4050.description:
Cast Genesis Chamber by paying {2}.
When Genesis Chamber enters the battlefield, Replication Specialist triggers, causing you to pay {1}{U} to create a token copy of Genesis Chamber.
Cast Emry from the command zone by paying {U}.
When Emry enters the battlefield, it and both Genesis Chambers trigger.
Resolve the Emry trigger, causing you to mill four cards.
Resolve both Genesis Chamber triggers, creating two 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Emry, adding {U}.
Choose to return Emry to the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Ayara, Widow of the Realm // Ayara, Furnace Queen

1405-2292-2923.notablePrerequisites: An opponent's life total is higher than or equal to your life total.
1405-2292-2923.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Ayara triggers, returning Scourge of the Throne from your graveyard to the battlefield, and giving it haste until end of turn.
Declare Scourge of the Throne as an attacker, attacking an opponent whose life total is higher than or equal to yours.
Scourge of the Throne's dethrone ability and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the second Scourge of the Throne trigger, causing you to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Scourge of the Throne, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the second Scourge of the Throne trigger from step 3, doing nothing.
Repeat each combat phase.

3490-3545-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
3490-3545-5231.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Sigil Captain triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on the Servo.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

2060-3490-3910-4017-4772.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional artifacts.
2060-3490-3910-4017-4772.description:
Activate Breya by paying {2} and sacrificing two other artifacts, causing you to gain 5 life.
Sunbond triggers, putting ten +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Repeat.

342-577-1314.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Soldevi Simulacrum.
342-577-1314.description:
Kill Soldevi Simulacrum.
Brenard triggers, exiling Soldevi Simulacrum from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it thats a 1/1 Food Golem artifact creature in addition to its other types.
Activate Soldevi Simulacrum by paying {0} due to Sam, giving Soldevi Simulacrum +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat step 3.

654-1018-1541-2292-5220.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Skullwinder.
When Skullwinder dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Skullwinder on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Hit the Mother Lode by paying {4}{R}{R}{R}, exiling Skullwinder from the top of your library and casting it without paying its mana cost, and creating seven tapped Treasure artifact tokens.
When Skullwinder and the Treasures enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers seven times and Skullwinder triggers once.
Resolve all Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Hit the Mother Lode from your graveyard to your hand, and causing an opponent to return a card from their graveyard to their hand.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

2517-4050-4681-5276.notablePrerequisites: Parallax Wave has at least one fade counter on it.
2517-4050-4681-5276.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Parallax Wave by removing a fade counter from it, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Leonin Relic-Warder trigger, exiling Parallax Wave.
When Parallax Wave leaves the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder, adding one mana of any color.
When Leonin Relic-Warder leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Parallax Wave from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Parallax Wave trigger from step 5, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

199-2573-4377-4861.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Islands.
199-2573-4377-4861.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons either from your hand or from your graveyard with buyback by paying {4}{U}{U} and sacrificing three Islands, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and returning Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Play an Island from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play two Islands from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

3259-4068-4538.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control a Mountain.
3259-4068-4538.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Dune-Brood Nephilim and the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury and Dune-Brood Nephilim trigger.
Resolve the Dune-Brood Nephilim trigger, creating a 1/1 Sand creature token for each land you control.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Sand token, untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

293-3263-3698-5220.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Narcomoeba, targeting yourself.
When Narcomoeba dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Narcomoeba on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability, causing you to mill three cards.
Narcomoeba triggers, returning itself to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Narcomoeba enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Repeat.

2265-2571-4490-4762.notablePrerequisites: Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness and does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2265-2571-4490-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
If Devoted Druid has a +1/+1 counter on it, repeat from step 1 until Devoted Druid has no +1/+1 counters.
Activate Devoted Druid's outlast ability by paying {G} and tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters on Devoted Druid.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Repeat from step 2.

1625-1642.notablePrerequisites:
Warlock Class is level three.
An opponent has at least twenty life.
1625-1642.description:
Cast Magister Sphinx by paying {4}{W}{U}{B}.
When Magister Sphinx enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing an opponent with at least twenty life to lose life until their life total is equal to ten.
At the beginning of your end step, Warlock Class triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent targeted by Magister Sphinx in step 1 loses the game due to having zero or less life.

2232-2459-3474-4050.description:
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Rograkh enters the battlefield, triggering Jedit Ojanen and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Jedit Ojanen trigger, causing you to pay {G} to create a 2/2 Cat Warrior creature token.
The Cat Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Rograkh from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Cat Warrior, adding {G}.
Repeat.
